narration: The pipeline begins with input map queries, representing prior knowledge and positions of map elements.
An offset prediction module estimates spatial displacements, which are added to reference points to define precise sampling locations.
At these predicted coordinates, multi-scale features are sampled from the Bird's Eye View feature grid.
Concurrently, an MLP predicts distribution parameters to dynamically sample adaptive attention weights via dynamic resampling.
The sampled features and attention weights enter the aggregation module, followed by a linear projection layer.
Finally, the updated map query residual is produced to iteratively refine the map representation.
